title: 第31章上淬骨功成锁龙御强敌第30章下千里跋涉火山寻获中级秘府
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 中级时隐玄虚的甬道比初级时隐玄虚长得多，也深得多。
铜灯在两侧石壁上依次亮起，暗金色的火焰跳动了几下便稳定下来，将甬道照得如同白昼。
苏余走在前面，脚步声在狭窄的空间里回荡，每一次落地都激起一圈极细的灰尘——这座时隐玄虚已经封闭了太久，久到连时族特制的避尘阵都开始失效。
林霜跟在他身后三步处。
她没有说话，但苏余能感觉到她的目光正落在自己后背上，那道目光里有审视，有探究，更多的是一种他自己也说不清的、柔软的注视。
自从在鬼哭崖交手之后，这个女人看他的眼神就变了——不是敌意，不是戒备，而是某种他从未在别人眼中见过的、让他有些不自在的东西。
他不知道该怎么回应。
在矿场待了三年的人，只学会了一种跟人打交道的方式：判断对方是敌是友，然后要么杀，要么防。
林霜既不是敌人，似乎也不只是盟友。
她救过他，他也救过她；她送他进传送阵，他带她跨越数千里从黑风岭逃到北域雪原。
两人之间的关系已经复杂到超出了他在矿场学会的那套简单二分法。
他决定不去想。
眼下有更重要的事。
甬道尽头是一扇石门，门上刻着时族篆文——不是之前在初级时隐玄虚见到的那种简单封印，而是一整套完整的血脉识别阵纹。
阵纹呈八角形，每一个角上都刻着一个“时”字的变体，八种变体互相勾连，构成一道闭环的暗金色锁链。
苏余将手背上的“时”字篆文按在阵纹中央。
暗金色光芒从他手背涌出，像流水般沿着八条锁链同时蔓延。
每一道锁链被光填满的瞬间便发出一声清脆的金属鸣响，八声响过，石门无声无息地向内滑开。
门后的景象让林霜倒吸了一口凉气。
那是一座规模远超预想的地下殿堂，穹顶高达数十丈，穹顶上嵌满了夜明珠，每一颗都有拳头大，散发着柔和如月光的光芒。
数百颗夜明珠同时发光，将整座殿堂照得如同白昼。
殿堂中央是一条笔直的石板路，路两侧整齐排列着石室、丹房、器室、藏经阁，所有建筑的风格都与鬼哭崖下的真遗迹如出一辙，但保存得更完好、规模更宏大。
“这就是时门的中级时隐玄虚？”
林霜环顾四周，声音里有掩饰不住的震撼。
时门在覆灭前，在北域雪原建了三座时隐玄虚。
初级那座是给外围弟子用的，这座是给核心弟子用的。”
苏余沿着石板路往前走，目光在两侧的石室门楣上扫过。
每一扇门上都刻着用途标注——“炼器室”“藏经阁”“灵兽栏”“灵石库”。
灵兽栏。
苏余停下脚步，推开那扇石门。
石室内部比他预想的要大，三丈见方，角落里堆着早已干涸的灵兽饲料残渣，墙壁上嵌着数枚休眠状态的驭兽令牌。
守种兽从他身后的青铜令牌中跃出，蹲在灵兽栏中央，发出一声低沉的、带着几分怀念的嗡鸣——它认得这个地方。
数百年前，时族的炼器长老就是在这里铸造了它。
“你在外面守着，我去找灵石库。”
苏余对守种兽吩咐了一声，然后转向林霜，“你也休息一下。
从黑风岭逃到这里，你体内的灵力还没完全恢复。”
林霜点了点头，在灵兽栏门口靠墙坐下，银白长剑横在膝上。
content_en:
The corridor of Yinxuanxu at the intermediate level is much longer and deeper than that at the elementary level.
The copper lamps lit up one after another on the stone walls on both sides. The dark golden flames bounced for a few times and then stabilized, illuminating the corridor like daylight.
Su Yu walked in front, his footsteps echoing in the narrow space, and every time he landed, he stirred up a circle of extremely fine dust - this Shiyin Xuanxu had been closed for so long that even the Shi Clan's special dust shielding array began to fail.
Lin Shuang followed him three steps behind.
She didn't speak, but Su Yu could feel her gaze falling on his back. There was scrutiny, probing, and more of a soft gaze that he couldn't explain.
Ever since the fight at Guiwai Cliff, the way this woman looked at him had changed - not hostility, not wariness, but something he had never seen in other people's eyes and made him a little uncomfortable.
He didn't know how to respond.
People who have been in the mine for three years have only learned one way to deal with people: judge whether the other party is a friend or an enemy, and then either kill or defend them.
Lin Shuang is neither an enemy nor an ally.
She had saved him, and he had saved her; she sent him into the teleportation array, and he took her to escape from the Black Wind Ridge to the snowfields of the Northern Territory across thousands of miles.
The relationship between the two had become more complex than the simple dichotomy he had learned in the mines.
He decided not to think about it.
There are more important things right now.
At the end of the corridor is a stone door, with the Shi clan's seal characters engraved on it - not the simple seal that I saw before when I was in the elementary level, but a complete set of bloodline identification formations.
The array pattern is octagonal, with a variant of the word "shi" engraved on each corner. The eight variants are connected with each other to form a closed-loop dark golden chain.
Su Yu pressed the seal character "Shi" on the back of his hand into the center of the formation pattern.
Dark golden light poured out from the back of his hand, spreading along the eight chains at the same time like running water.
The moment each chain was filled with light, there was a crisp metallic sound. After eight sounds, the stone door slid inwards silently.
The scene behind the door made Lin Shuang take a breath.
It was an underground palace that was much larger than expected. The dome was dozens of feet high. The dome was filled with luminous pearls, each one as big as a fist, emitting a light as soft as moonlight.
Hundreds of luminous pearls glowed at the same time, illuminating the entire palace as if it were daytime.
In the center of the hall is a straight stone road. On both sides of the road are stone chambers, alchemy chambers, utensil chambers, and scripture collection pavilions. The style of all buildings is exactly the same as the real ruins at the foot of Guiwei Cliff, but they are better preserved and larger in scale.
"Is this the intermediate Tokiyin Xuanxu of Tokimon?"
Lin Shuang looked around, unable to conceal the shock in his voice.
"Yes.
Before the Shimen was destroyed, three Shiyinxuanxu were built in the snowy plains of the Northern Territory.
The junior one is for peripheral disciples, and this one is for core disciples. "
Su Yu walked forward along the stone road, his eyes scanning the lintels of the stone chambers on both sides.
Each door is engraved with a purpose label - "Item Refining Room", "Sutra Storage Pavilion", "Spiritual Beast Column" and "Spiritual Stone Storehouse".
Spirit animal pen.
Su Yu stopped and pushed open the stone door.
The interior of the stone chamber was larger than he expected, measuring three feet square. There were piles of long-dried spirit beast feed residue in the corners, and several dormant beast control tokens were embedded in the walls.
The seed-guarding beast jumped out from the bronze token behind him, squatted in the center of the spirit beast pen, and let out a low, somewhat nostalgic hum - it recognized this place.
Hundreds of years ago, the weapon-making elders of the Shi clan forged it here.
"You stay outside and I'll go find the spiritual stone library."
Su Yu gave instructions to the seed-keeping beast, and then turned to Lin Shuang, "You should also take a rest.
After escaping here from Black Wind Ridge, the spiritual power in your body has not yet fully recovered. "
Lin Shuang nodded and sat down against the wall at the door of the spirit beast pen, with the silver-white sword across his knees.
title_en: Chapter 31: Tempering the bones and successfully locking the dragon to defend against powerful enemies. Chapter 30: Traveling thousands of miles to the volcano to find the intermediate secret palace.
